# Contact codes: every network

<!-- generated by tools/gen_contact_docs.py from src/bobina/contact.py: do not edit by hand -->

One block, ```` ```contact NETWORK ````, with the value in the body: a phone with its country code, a user
name or the link the app shares. bobina builds the network's public link, prints it as a QR code and
writes a caption under it. The same text is in `bobina help contact NETWORK` (`--json` for programs).
The block itself: [FORMAT.md §6.8](FORMAT.md).

Codes that only the app can draw (Snapcode, Spotify Code, the WeChat and KakaoTalk QR codes, Kik Code)
are never imitated: bobina prints a plain QR code of the public link, which any phone camera opens.
No brand logos.

| Attribute | Means |
|---|---|
| `caption=` | `auto` (default: "WhatsApp +55 11 90000-0000"), `none`, or your own text |
| `width=` `module=` `ecc=` `.left` `.right` | as on a ```` ```qr ```` block |

## Messengers and calls

### `whatsapp` — WhatsApp

⚠ not tested in the app

````markdown
```contact whatsapp
+55 11 90000-0000
```
````

The body: a phone with the country code, or a chat.whatsapp.com group, whatsapp.com/channel or wa.me/c catalog link.
`text=`: a message the chat opens with (the person can still edit it).

Link format: WhatsApp Help Center, 'How to use click to chat' (wa.me/NUMBER, ?text=); Meta developers, catalog links (wa.me/c/NUMBER).

### `telegram` — Telegram

⚠ not tested in the app

````markdown
```contact telegram
@ana_souza
```
````

The body: a user name or channel (@name), a +invite or t.me link, or a phone (+55 …).

Link format: core.telegram.org/api/links (t.me/USERNAME, t.me/+INVITE, t.me/+PHONE).

### `signal` — Signal

⚠ not tested in the app

````markdown
```contact signal
+55 11 90000-0000
```
````

The body: a phone with the country code, or the signal.me link of a user name.

Link format: Signal-Desktop ts/util/signalRoutes.ts (signal.me/#p/PHONE, signal.me/#eu/USERNAME).

### `wechat` — WeChat

⚠ not tested in the app

````markdown
```contact wechat
https://u.wechat.com/kAbCdEfGhIjKlMnOpQrStUv
```
````

The body: the link inside your WeChat QR code (Me › My QR Code, read with any QR reader).
WeChat draws its own code (the contact QR in the app); bobina prints a plain QR of the public link instead.

Link format: WeChat has no public link format for an ID: the link of the app's own QR is reprinted.

⚠ not tested in the app

⚠ not tested in the app

````markdown

````

The body: a phone with the country code: the code opens a text message to it.

Link format: RFC 5724 (sms:NUMBER?body=).


The body: an e-mail address.

Link format: RFC 6068 (mailto:).

## Contact cards (name, phone…)

### `vcard` — vCard (also `card`, `contact`)

⚠ not tested in the app

````markdown
```contact vcard
name: Ana Souza
phone: +55 11 90000-0000
email: ana@example.com
```
````

The body: key: value lines: name, phone, email, org, title, url, address, note.

Link format: RFC 2426 (vCard 3.0, the version phone cameras read).

### `mecard` — MeCard

⚠ not tested in the app

````markdown
```contact mecard
name: Ana Souza
phone: +55 11 90000-0000
```
````

The body: key: value lines: name, phone, email, url, address, note.

Link format: NTT DOCOMO MeCard (MECARD:N:…;TEL:…;;).
